title: nephrodium filix-mas var. affine
intro: Nephrodium filix-mas var. affine, commonly known as the Lady Fern, is a plant species belonging to the Osmundaceae family. It is known for its therapeutic properties and has been used in traditional medicine for centuries to treat various health conditions. The Lady Fern has been used to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties, as well as its ability to soothe and calm the nervous system. The plant contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
